description: #53 CRIT-2: a private repository at Repair whose rules read answers 200 with something that isn't a list of rules, so the case can't be decided and the private item fails closed. Only the preconditions run: mode's drift reads the same answer as a list (pre-existing, recorded on #53's PR).

habit_lines: 这次没能判断这个 private 仓库的规则是否生效：GitHub 的回答在重试一次后仍然没读到或读不懂，所以按未通过处理，运行停止。
解决办法：稍后再运行一次治理；在判断出规则生效之前，运行不会继续。
